title: Forms in the block editor: the synced form keeps its preselection on save, the blocks and a new form's template, the preselection follows its TEXT, a notification link opens it selected
description: The forms module in the block editor, ONE login and ONE editor boot on the page that uses a synced form: (1) saved as it is, the editor does not drop the content it cannot render (the pattern override with defaultOption) and the page still preselects; (2) the ten blocks are registered, the form is not in the inserter (2.0.0: a page gets the reference block) and a new Form block comes with its template and two notifications; (3) the side panel keeps the preselection on its option's TEXT when the options are reordered or the option removed; (4) «Forms › Forms» links a notification to its form's editor: assets/notification-link.js selects it and opens the sidebar with its «To». The forms seed (/estrategia-web-forms-test/v1/reset) puts the site in en_US. Read by browser-forms-editor. It was admin.test.mjs (level 3) until 29-10-2026.

parameters.expression: (() => { const select = wp.blocks.createBlock('estrategia-web-forms/select', { label: 'Servicio', name: 'servicio', options: 'Hoteles\nRestaurantes\nBarcos', defaultOption: 2 }); wp.data.dispatch('core/block-editor').resetBlocks([wp.blocks.createBlock('estrategia-web-forms/form', { formId: 'f' }, [select])]); wp.data.dispatch('core/block-editor').selectBlock(select.clientId); wp.data.dispatch('core/edit-post').openGeneralSidebar('edit-post/block'); window.__select = select.clientId; })()
